# Manoj Tours and Travels (Manoj Taxi Service)
> 24×7 Cab & Taxi Service in Bangalore, Karnataka, India

Manoj Tours and Travels (also operating as Manoj Taxi Service) is a trusted local, outstation, and airport cab service headquartered in Bangalore, Karnataka. Available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for immediate and advance taxi bookings.

## Core Services

### 1. One Way Outstation Cabs
- Pay only for a one-side drop fare, with no return-trip charges.
- Point-to-point doorstep pickup in Bangalore and drop to any outstation city.
- Sedan and SUV options available 24×7.
- Popular routes: Bangalore to Mysore, Bangalore to Tirupati, Bangalore to Chennai, Bangalore to Hyderabad, Bangalore to Mangalore.
- URL: https://www.manojtoursandtravels.in/services/outstation-cabs

### 2. Round Trip Outstation Cabs
- Transparent per-kilometre billing with a minimum daily running of 300 km.
- Daily driver allowance (Driver Bata) applies per calendar day.
- Ideal for weekend tours, family vacations, hill stations, and temple pilgrimages.
- Sedan, SUV (Innova / Innova Crysta), and Tempo Traveller options available.
- Popular routes: Bangalore to Ooty, Coorg, Chikmagalur, Wayanad, Munnar, Goa, Kanyakumari.
- URL: https://www.manojtoursandtravels.in/services/round-trip-cabs

### 3. Local Hourly Cab Packages
- 8 Hours / 80 Kilometres base package for city travel.
- Clearly defined extra kilometre and extra hour rates.
- Ideal for city errands, business meetings, Bangalore sightseeing (Bangalore Palace, Lalbagh, Cubbon Park, Bannerghatta).
- URL: https://www.manojtoursandtravels.in/services/local-cabs

### 4. Bangalore Airport Pickup & Drop (Kempegowda International Airport - BLR)
- 24×7 reliable transfer to and from Kempegowda International Airport.
- Timely doorstep pickup across Bangalore (Electronic City, Whitefield, Koramangala, Indiranagar, HSR Layout, JP Nagar, Kanakapura Road, Hebbal, etc.).
- Late night and early morning airport transfers with zero cancellations.
- URL: https://www.manojtoursandtravels.in/services/airport-pickup-drop

## Vehicle Fleet
- Swift Dzire: Sedan (4 passengers, 2 medium bags, AC) - ideal for budget outstation drops and airport transfers.
- Toyota Etios: Sedan (4 passengers, 3 bags, AC) - spacious legroom and large boot space.
- Toyota Innova: SUV (6-7 passengers, 4 bags, AC) - comfortable family travel for hill stations.
- Toyota Innova Crysta: Premium SUV (6-7 passengers, 5 bags, AC) - executive comfort and long-distance luxury.
- Force Urbania / Tempo Traveller: Group Van (9-16 passengers, ample luggage space, AC) - group tours and corporate outings.
- Fleet URL: https://www.manojtoursandtravels.in/fleet

## Geographic Coverage & Key Corridors
- Primary Hub: Bangalore (all localities: Kanakapura Road, Kaggalipura, Banashankari, Jayanagar, JP Nagar, Electronic City, Whitefield, Koramangala, Indiranagar, HSR Layout, Marathahalli, Bellandur, Sarjapur, BTM Layout, Hebbal, Yelahanka, Majestic, BLR Airport).
- Karnataka Routes: Mysore, Nandi Hills, Coorg (Madikeri), Chikmagalur, Sakleshpur, Hampi, Gokarna, Murudeshwar, Mangalore, Udupi, Belur, Halebidu, Bandipur, Kabini, Shivanasamudra.
- Tamil Nadu Routes: Ooty, Coonoor, Kodaikanal, Chennai, Coimbatore, Salem, Madurai, Tiruvannamalai, Kanyakumari.
- Andhra Pradesh & Telangana: Tirupati (Balaji Darshan), Mantralayam, Vijayawada, Hyderabad.
- Kerala Routes: Wayanad, Munnar, Alleppey, Kochi, Thekkady, Kovalam.
- Goa Routes: Panaji, Calangute, Baga, South Goa.

## Transparent Policies
- Toll fees, state entry taxes/permits, and parking charges are charged at actuals.
- Clear upfront quotes provided over phone or WhatsApp prior to journey confirmation.
- Accepted Payment Methods: Cash, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking.
